review_kind: Independent ordinary read-only review of initial bounded register-flow candidate
authority: Findings only. No implementation, approval, publication, migration coverage or criterion award.
scope: Finite low32 reaching-definitions/uses-after analysis on the existing index, asserted entries, pending delay contexts, conservative unknowns, input grammar and resource limits. One-user local read-only tool. No protected resources.

findings.title: Reachable query roots discard other reachable unknown frontiers and falsely report complete definitions
findings.what: Graph construction records reachable unknown frontiers in blockedReasons. Those reasons are retained only when no graph root reaches the query.
findings.problem: A known path reaches the query while another reachable path stops at an unmodeled instruction or unresolved indirect jump. The unknown path can carry an unmodeled predecessor or delay-slot definition into the same selected query. Existing code returns complete_within_asserted_scope=true with no reasons and omits that uncertainty.

repros.expected: Retain known provenance and mark incomplete unsupported_instruction. Reserved primary0x3a at0x10008 is actually unsupported in the decoded index.

Mark incomplete unresolved_indirect_exit without inventing an edge. Oldr8==0x10010 makes JRcapturethe selectedtarget before delayADDIU at0x1000c definesr8. The known branch path alone cannot establish complete definitions.

findings.smallest_fix: For nonzero reaching_defs with reachable roots, retain reachable unknown frontier reasons except known out_of_scope_direct_target. A conservative held result is sufficient; do not synthesize targets, add another graph or infer call returns. Preserve uses-after value traversal so a definite kill shields later unknown effects. Document any conservative over-holding.
findings.if_skipped: Downstream consumers can mistake a partial definition list for a complete local answer, particularly around foreign readers or alternate unknown control paths.
findings.owner_disposition: Root accepted both repros as one finding and plans conservative frontier propagation plus permanent regressions and a source-oracle correction. Implementation and revised goldens were not reviewed in this initial report.
findings.review_correction: The first promptly sent message named0xffffffff as unknown; that is actually a modeled SD. Before publication the reviewer corrected it to0xe8000000, reran both builds, verified actual unsupported operand status, and notified root. Current retained repros use the corrected word.

reuse_and_readability: One pure graph/query owner is justified by execution-context/worklist invariants and has one reference-owner caller. It consumes the existing decoder and mapping lifecycle, builds one graph per batch, keeps predecessor-specific delays, and preserves source-scoped unknowns. No concrete duplicate handler/new helper or additional readability finding was established. Correctness finding takes precedence over growth claims.
